## Definition

- **Tier:** `anchored`
- **Semantic types:** `T058`, `T059`, `T060`, `T061`, `T062`, `T063`, `T065`
- **Children:** [`therapeutic_procedure`](therapeutic_procedure_NER_validation.md), [`diagnostic_procedure`](diagnostic_procedure_NER_validation.md)
- **Counts toward `clinical_any`:** yes
- **Development-corpus prevalence:** 11.7% of content tokens, 935 distinct word types ([measured](../../measurements/category_prevalence.json))

## Definition in words

Things done to or for the patient — operations, therapies, imaging, lab work and other health-care activities. Split into therapeutic and diagnostic because "the treatment was corrupted" and "the test was corrupted" are different experiments.

A gold standard adjudicates this category directly. Precision, recall and F1 can be reported against expert annotations.

## Benchmark

### [i2b2/VA 2010 concept extraction](https://portal.dbmi.hms.harvard.edu/projects/n2c2-nlp/)

- **Maps to:** `test + treatment (partial — i2b2 treatment also covers drugs)`
- **Corpus:** Partners, Beth Israel Deaconess and UPMC notes
- **Size:** 170 training / 256 test summaries
- **Access:** DBMI data-use agreement
- **Paper:** https://doi.org/10.1136/amiajnl-2011-000203

Three categories only: problem, test, treatment. `treatment` covers both procedures and drugs, so it can only ever partially anchor either.

### [SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge](https://physionet.org/content/snomed-ct-entity-challenge/)

- **Maps to:** `procedure`
- **Corpus:** 272 MIMIC-IV discharge notes
- **Size:** 75,491 annotations of 6,595 concepts as released (74,808 / 6,624 as published)
- **Access:** PhysioNet credentialed
- **Paper:** https://doi.org/10.1093/jamia/ocaf104

Six clinical annotators, ~70% double-annotated with a third adjudicating disagreements. Same corpus family as the development notes, which is why it is the primary anchor.

### Protocol

Per [`validation/protocol.md`](../../protocol.md):

1. Tag the gold corpus, map gold labels onto this category via the crosswalk above.
2. Report **targeting precision** first — of the edits placed under this category, what fraction hit a gold span of the mapped label. This is the package's actual claim.
3. Report strict and relaxed P/R/F1 for completeness, with cluster-bootstrap CIs **by `patient_id`**.
4. Run the L0-L4 ablation so each method addition gets a number.
